The '''BOC customer computer net''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network maintained by the [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]]. It could be accessed by their [[GCC-1000]] [[Currency/Legends|currency]] converter and was constantly updated with currency exchange rate information.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
